bookSourceComment: Penrix 私人版 TWKAN。搜索同时尝试用户原始关键词与简转繁关键词，解决同站索引简繁混存导致的漏书；搜索结果、详情、目录与正文统一转简。正文净化先做 Unicode 兼容分解并剥离组合音符，把花体/叠加音符域名还原成可识别的 twkan.com，再全局删除记域名、追台湾小说、Google 搜索、分享等内嵌推广，避免广告进入原生阅读和 TTS。

<js>
(function(){
  var out=new Packages.java.util.ArrayList();
  var collect=function(html){
    if(!html)return;
    java.setContent(String(html));
    var list=java.getElements('#article_list_content li');
    if(list){for(var i=0;i<list.size();i++)out.add(list.get(i));}
  };
  collect(String(result||''));
  var key=String(java.get('penrixTwkanKey')||'');
  var alt=String(java.s2t(key)||'');
  if(alt && alt!==key){
    var cfg=JSON.stringify({method:'POST',body:'searchkey='+java.encodeURI(alt)+'&searchtype=all',charset:'utf8'});
    try{collect(String(java.ajax('https://twkan.com/search,'+cfg)||''));}catch(e){}
  }
  return out;
})()
</js>

var Normalizer=Packages.java.text.Normalizer; var Form=Packages.java.text.Normalizer.Form; var html=String(Normalizer.normalize(String(result||''),Form.NFKD)); // TWKAN now decorates Latin letters with stacked combining marks. Strip marks first so // t+marks w+marks k+marks a+marks n.com becomes the stable token twkan.com. html=html.replace(/[\u0300-\u036f\u1ab0-\u1aff\u1dc0-\u1dff\u20d0-\u20ff\ufe20-\ufe2f]/g,''); // Drop complete bracketed promotion blocks, including current '记一下我们域名 / 追台湾小说 / 超靠谱' variants. html=html.replace(/[【〖\[](?=[^】〗\]]{0,800}(?:[記记](?:住本站|一下我们)域名|追(?:台|臺)[灣湾]小说|(?:twkan|69shux)\s*\.\s*com|超靠谱|GOOGLE\s*搜索\s*TWKAN))[^】〗\]]{0,800}[】〗\]]/gi,''); // Same promotion can occasionally arrive without brackets or with markup splitting the surrounding block. html=html.replace(/写到这里[^<\r\n]{0,500}(?:[記记]一下我们域名|追(?:台|臺)[灣湾]小说|twkan\s*\.\s*com|超靠谱)[^<\r\n]{0,500}/gi,''); html=html.replace(/〖[^〗]{0,500}[記记]住本站域名[^〗]{0,500}〗/gi,''); html=html.replace(/〖[^〗]{0,500}(?:twkan|69shux)[^〗]{0,500}〗/gi,''); html=html.replace(/(?:GOOGLE\s*搜索\s*TWKAN|把本網(?:站)?分享到[^<\r\n]{0,220}|把本网站分享到[^<\r\n]{0,220})/gi,''); html=html.replace(/(?:台|臺)[灣湾](?:小[説說说]|小說|小说)(?:網|网)[^<\r\n]{0,180}(?:twkan\.com)?/gi,function(m){return /twkan|本站域名|我们域名|分享|搜索|超靠谱/i.test(m)?'':m;}); html=html.replace(/(?:www\.)?(?:twkan|69shux)\s*\.\s*com/gi,''); html=html.replace(/(?:]*>\s*)?本章完[。.!！]?\s*(?:<\/p>)?/gi,''); html=html.replace(/(?:\s*){3,}/gi,'

'); html=String(Normalizer.normalize(html,Form.NFKC)); java.t2s(html);
